description: Returns Shprd's verse of the day in the World English Bible: one verse (or a short passage) chosen for each calendar day, the same one the Shprd app shows. Use this when the user asks for the verse of the day, today's verse, a daily verse, or a verse to start the morning. Pass the user's local date as `date` when you know it; without it, today in UTC is used. Dates more than a few days from today get a verse from a fixed rotation. Returns the reference, the exact WEB text and the credit; in hosts with cards it also shows the verse in the Shprd reader card. It does not look up a specific passage and does not search.

date.description: The calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-20". Omit for today (UTC).

name: get_verse_of_the_day
title: Verse of the day
